title: Nourishing Italian Chicken Pasta
description: A bitter, fluffy, and energizing Italian dish featuring honey and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, this recipe is perfect for a healthy dinner option. The brine-wet chicken adds moisture and flavor to the dish.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the whole wheat pasta according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together honey, olive oil, turmeric, salt, and black pepper to make the sauce.
In a large skillet, heat the sauce over medium heat and add the brine-wet chicken breast, cooking until browned on both sides and cooked through.
Add the garlic and dandelion greens to the skillet and cook until the greens are wilted.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sauce and chicken.
Serve the pasta hot, topped with grated parmesan cheese.
Garnish with additional dandelion greens if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
